task: Investigate in the Hugging Face documentation how to utilize the 'Trainer' API for training a model on a custom dataset, and note the configurable parameters of the Trainer class.
answer: Final Response: How to utilize the Trainer API for training on a custom dataset (Hugging Face Transformers docs): 1) Prepare the custom dataset and tokenize/preprocess it (e.g., with datasets.load_dataset or your own torch Dataset). 2) Define a TrainingArguments object (the args parameter) holding all training hyperparameters such as learning_rate, num_train_epochs, per_device_train_batch_size, output_dir. 3) Instantiate the trainer: trainer = Trainer(model=model, args=training_args, train_dataset=train_dataset, eval_dataset=eval_dataset, data_collator=..., processing_class/tokenizer=..., compute_metrics=...). 4) Launch training with trainer.train() (and evaluate with trainer.evaluate()). Configurable constructor parameters of the Trainer class: model, args, data_collator, train_dataset, eval_dataset, processing_class, model_init, compute_metrics, callbacks, optimizers, preprocess_logits_for_metrics.
